source: direct APK extraction + visual recovery + user-confirmed mapping
description: Shoe icon frames 0900..0909 were recovered by visually matching the real APK inventory icon atlas against the real APK property18 character-layer resources. The APK does not expose a direct icon_code -> property18 table, so this catalog records the user-confirmed compatibility mapping without claiming an official server-side item table.

appearance_resource.client_rule: pmsj/work/b/v.D(property18): property18=0 clears character layer8; nonzero property18=N uses image_id=19000+N
appearance_resource.note: image19000 exists in the APK, but property18=0 is a client-side clear operation and is therefore not assigned to any confirmed visible shoe icon in this mapping.

notes: All icon pixels and all 190xx character-layer pixels used for this recovery were extracted from the uploaded APK with SHA-256 34348c4ac16108222871203c46faabc1e6e5383c455e39b871c7666505da60b5.
